extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in theology, religious history, and critiques of Christian doctrines (freethinkers, students of 19th-century religious polemics)
extracted.subtask_description: A polemical 1890 essay arguing against the doctrine of eternal punishment (hell), surveying Biblical passages, patristic and medieval teachings, and Protestant confessions to critique the historical and moral effects of belief in eternal torment.
